title: Find The Original Array of Prefix Xor
summary: Given an integer array pref of size n, find and return an array arr of size n such that for each index i, the element pref[i] is equal to the bitwise-xor of the first i+1 elements of arr.
statement: Given an integer array pref of size n, find and return an array arr of size n such that for each index i, the element pref[i] is equal to the bitwise-xor of the first i+1 elements of arr. It can be proven that the solution is unique.
constraints: pref[i] is nums[0] XOR ... XOR nums[i].
Recover and return the unique original nums array.
hints: The first original value equals the first prefix XOR.
For i>0, pref[i-1] XOR pref[i] cancels all earlier original values and leaves nums[i].
Append pref[0], then XOR each adjacent prefix pair.
XOR self-cancellation proves each recovered value, and the defining prefix relation makes the reconstruction unique.
editorial: XOR self-cancellation proves each recovered value, and the defining prefix relation makes the reconstruction unique.

tests.explanation: The first value is five and adjacent prefix XORs yield seven, two, three, and two.
A one-element prefix array is identical to its original array.
